_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Reviewer access for the JOSHUA profile; one profile per username
detail: JOSHUA (profile_028abec8…) can flag cards and open the data and model panel with Cmd/Ctrl+I, but sees no admin settings, changelog modal, provenance pills or scrape inspector. It is allow-listed by profile ID, not display name.
A username now belongs to one profile, compared case-insensitively. The worker refuses a second profile with the same name or with an unclaimed legacy name (needs migration 0007 and a worker deploy).
The sign-in match dialog no longer offers 'No, create an account' for a name that already exists.

entries.summary: Tutorial: finer-grained steps, new demo words, plural merging in Smart Skip, card always fits
detail: Front: rank and frequency are separate steps. Back: the sense row, then each meaning row, the usage bars, the example, its English, its source, then Rare uses, Review meanings and Look up.
Demo cards are now quiero (querer, three meanings) in Spanish and parece (parecer, two short meanings) in Portuguese, replacing que and provar.
Smart Skip shows that singular and plural nouns with identical meanings share a card (Spanish and Portuguese).
The card no longer scrolls inside itself: on narrow phones it is scaled down (not below 70%) so every row is visible, and the page scrolls the rest.

entries.summary: Tutorial: back of the card builds up too; spotlight ring follows its element
detail: The back of the card starts blank: meanings, rare uses, review meanings, usage bars, example and look-up each appear as they are explained.
The spotlight ring is re-measured continuously and corrects for page zoom, so it stays around its element after rows open, flips settle or text size changes.

entries.summary: Tutorial: one banner, a card that builds up, clearer Speech or music, tighter grading note, whole spotlight ring
detail: Banner now reads Section · Title — Text on one line; the section is no longer repeated beside the title.
The front of the card starts blank and each element fades in as its note is explained.
Speech or music explains each source from first principles, including the two ways to choose music (pick artists, or build from a Spotify playlist).
Grade your answer note cut to one short sentence.
The yellow spotlight is now a ring drawn over the card and clamped inside it, so it is never clipped or pushed off screen (desktop and phone).

entries.summary: Use distinct URLs for the corrected decks’ supporting files
detail: Version the Spanish/Portuguese Merge Lemmas, cognate verdicts, frequencies and estimation pools so browser caches cannot substitute old v23 files.
Preserve the latest UI and all existing source scores, frequencies and merging rules.

entries.summary: Make corrected Spanish and Portuguese speech decks the defaults
detail: Default speech decks now use HEADWAY Spanish r4 and Portuguese r2, including déjalo → dejar / Verb; no special review URL is required.
Refresh deck-bound Merge Lemmas, cognate card decisions, frequency bindings and estimation pools using existing data and existing policies.
Keep the current staging UI; no new WSD, harvest or model download. Missing coverage assets are explicitly declared absent.

entries.summary: Plan TAGLINE: evaluate Portuguese sentence tagging and WSD safeguards
detail: Added a named roadmap job to compare contextual POS taggers with a no-tagger baseline, starting with verified Portuguese és classification failures.
Keep source lemma corrections separate from sentence tagging and app display; use existing frozen evidence before any approved regeneration.

entries.summary: Simpler progress modal, tidier level and set explainers, and you can now step back through companion cards.
detail: Progress modal: single title row with language flag; removed Study history, action buttons and Refresh; coverage says it is based on speech you understand, not cards answered; Skipped box shown when Smart Skip is on
Level explainer: title is 'Choose where to begin' (centred), levels described as 100 cards, shorter centred estimate box with time hint
Set explainer: titles removed; New, Rev, Known and Skip pills with coloured labels
Left arrow/button now steps back between companion cards of a word opened from search or lyrics

entries.summary: Log in now asks only for a username; the birthday appears only if the account has one set.
detail: Birthday fields hidden in Log in mode until a matching profile has a birthday password
Wrong or missing birthday shows an inline message
Unknown username on Log in says to use Create account instead of silently creating one

entries.summary: Account modal: Spotify row now matches the profile row (circle, text, pill); top bar shows an account icon instead of the username.
detail: Spotify circle is the same size as the profile avatar, no embedded card background
Connect to Spotify pill is green; Disconnect is red, styled like Log out
Account avatar shows only the first letter of the username
Top bar shows an account icon for named users; guests still see GUEST and tapping it opens log in / create account

entries.summary: Yearless birthday selects, separate 'Is this you?' modal, centered F logo, and guest button parity
detail: Replace native date picker inputs with day and month dropdown selectors in both the profile login form and account settings, eliminating unwanted year prompts.
Surface profile collisions in a dedicated 'Is this you?' modal dialog with 'Yes, continue' and 'No, create an account' choices instead of filling up the landing page.
Remove 'Fluency' title text and center the 'F' app logo and header copy on the authentication landing sheet.
Give 'Try as guest' identical card formatting and typography to Log in and Create account, with an arrow indicator and temporary guest icon.

entries.summary: HEADWAY: constrain Portuguese forms to their supported source meanings
detail: Corrected Portuguese form imports that pulled unrelated parts of speech from the base word; preserved genuine separate meanings and left missing evidence unresolved.

Reprocessed only affected cards using existing frozen sentences. Final candidate decks are reviewed through staging release selection; this checkpoint does not redeploy or replace the staging interface.
Save release files in chunks to reduce avoidable memory spikes.

entries.summary: Vocabulary source layout, level scrubber dots, Smart Skip primer, and streamlined auth & settings
detail: Simplify vocabulary source card: remove outer border box, widen desktop spacing around OR divider, enlarge Spotify icon, and clarify title and frequency copy.
Scrubber dots: suppress dot under the active level and show status dots (green for completed, yellow for review needed, white for in-progress) on other levels.
Refine Smart Skip primer modal: remove redundant headers and look-alike footnote text, focusing directly on language choices.
Swap button emphasis in frequency intro modal so tutorial is primary and skip intro is secondary.
Streamline account settings with single Connect to Spotify button and native date-of-birth input.
Introduce distinct Log in and Create account entry points on authentication modal with native date picker.

entries.summary: HEADWAY: Spanish and Portuguese headword candidates ready for staging
detail: Corrected source lemma analyses and carried the supported fixes into new candidate decks, preserving surface identities, source evidence and genuine multiword expressions.
Candidate staging decks use their own study structure and existing Merge Lemmas data. Production deck choices and merging policy remain unchanged.
Save existing word-sense results gradually and read sentences and assignments as needed, reducing local memory use.

entries.summary: Active card controls cleanup, prominence meter visual linking, and study options simplification
detail: Permanently remove bottom-middle shortcuts and suggestions on active desktop cards to eliminate pill occlusion.
Permanently disable swipe onboarding pill ('← Needs practice · Got it →') on desktop devices via CSS and JS platform detection.
Replace review meanings bookmark icon with a circular redo/review curved arrow icon.
Replace rare uses tile icon with 0-of-3 empty bars to visually link with the card prominence meter.
Significantly enlarge the commonness tooltip (16px font, comfortable padding) for clear legibility.
Simplify card study options sheet: remove redundant 'Study settings' button, rename to 'Speak text', and enlarge menu icons.
Clean up main Settings Study tab: remove 'Speak the word' and promote Spaced repetition to the top with explainer 'Bring back learned words'.

entries.summary: HEADWAY: corrected Spanish and Portuguese headwords prepared for staging review
detail: Correct source lemma imports and preserve attached pronouns, specialised meanings and distinct verb/noun analyses.
Restore supported earlier Spanish clitic corrections and preserve curated overrides.
Re-score affected cards on existing frozen sentences; production decks remain unchanged.
Staging candidate selection loads the candidate’s study structure and Merge Lemmas data.

entries.summary: Settings modal enhancements: App tab, birthday passwords, Spotify SVG branding, Your Words icons, and full-width modals
detail: Rename Settings 'Account' tab to 'App' and move the Account section button to the bottom.
Clean up Account modal: user name inside avatar circle without repetition, larger logout pill, and replace secret word with Birthday password.
Replace music note with official Spotify SVG logo inline with connection status, drop redundant 'Spotify' heading, and add 'Used for lyrics mode' note.
Refine 'Your words': remove saved words list, fix font size consistency across all rows, and replace text pills with circular SVG action icons.
Make settings modals full width (edge-to-edge on mobile, 860px on desktop) with a prominent circular SVG close button.

entries.summary: Refine resume set modal hierarchy and remove mobile language chip chevron
detail: Invert resume modal hierarchy: 'Welcome back' is now the primary centered heading and 'Pick up where you left off' is a subtle subtitle.
Enlarge language name, level/set, and last card word readouts, and center the resume modal layout.
Remove redundant 'Learn new'/'Practice' track tag and strip 'speech' suffix from language name in resume prompt.
Rename resume action to 'Continue set' and remove colored accent outline in favor of clean solid focus styling.
Remove top bar language chevron so long language names like 'Portuguese' are never obscured on mobile.

entries.summary: AIRLOCK: Establish isolated staging deployment and deliberate promotion workflow
detail: Staging hosted at https://fluency-staging.pages.dev/ with clear amber environment identification and title badge.
Browser and backend isolation: separate IndexedDB database ('fluency-offline-staging') and wire sync namespacing ('stg_*') ensure real learning progress is 100% protected.
Candidate deck selection: staging can select candidate deck versions via config, query parameters, or interactive Developer settings without replacing production data.
Repeatable publication and promotion: `make stage` publishes proposed changes to Cloudflare Pages; `make promote` deliberately promotes only the reviewed commit, blocking unreviewed changes.
Staging service worker skipWaiting enables immediate asset loading on phone and laptop.

entries.summary: Select particular meanings to review in a centered, scrollable modal
detail: Replace the known-count control with a bookmark and Review meaning(s).
Select meanings using one checkbox per row; retain selections automatically without Save or Next Card buttons.
Center the dialog on mobile and desktop, with scrolling for long lists and keyboard focus handling.
Preserve individually marked meanings when answering the whole card; keep the existing review-card presentation.

entries.summary: Merge Lemmas works again in Czech and Finnish before a set opens
detail: Czech, Finnish and French Merge Lemmas lists rebuilt for their live decks. The app had ignored them (Czech's was built for v21; Finnish's and French's predated the plural/singular rule), so nothing merged until a set's senses loaded.

Verb forms merge from the start again: 4,179 Czech cards (into být, jít…) and 862 Finnish (into olla, saada…). Nouns stay separate until the plural/singular check runs for those languages (roadmap CONVOY).
French has nothing to merge yet: its 200-card deck carries no headwords.
A new app test stops any deploy whose live deck lacks a list built for it.

entries.summary: Activate verified noun merges in Spanish and Portuguese Speech decks
detail: Publish matching v23 metadata for 314 Spanish and 335 Portuguese noun groups, shared by Smart Skip, the level estimator and deck grouping.
Recover SpanishDict evidence for 773 candidate spellings and Wiktionary entry tags from the saved dump; keep changed, incomplete or ambiguous menus separate.
Preserve card IDs, saved progress, definitions and examples; verify all 20,000 full and early-loading decisions agree.

entries.summary: Memory tip sheet text gets side padding
detail: Text no longer touches the sheet's left edge.

entries.summary: Fix: Memory tip sheet now shows its explanation (the body had collapsed to nothing)
detail: The sheet's text area had no height, so only the title showed. It now sizes to its content.

entries.summary: Fix: Memory tip tile now actually appears (it was reading the wrong language variable)
detail: The first release looked up the language by a name that does not exist, so no card ever got a tip. It now uses selectedLanguage.

entries.summary: Memory tip tile on the card back shows how a word's ending maps to English (rápidamente → rapidly)
detail: New Memory tip tile beside Rarer uses; opens a small sheet naming the shift, e.g. -mente becomes -ly, -ción becomes -tion.
Spanish, Portuguese and French endings; a tip appears only when the card's own English gloss really wears the English ending, so false friends such as actualmente and chica get none.
Shown on any matching card, not only with Smart Skip off.

entries.summary: Noun forms merge only when every dictionary sense matches and both words have one noun entry
detail: Keep ser/seres and poder/poderes separate: noun and verb entries remain distinct even when their headword spelling matches.
Compare complete original SpanishDict and Wiktionary menus before filtering or display inflection; reject missing evidence and number-specific senses.
Invalidate earlier noun approvals and preserve the same decision in Smart Skip, deck grouping and early-loading indexes. Existing releases need refreshed source metadata to approve noun pairs.

entries.summary: Polish landing layout: prominent titles, level scrubber badge, target example words, card range nomenclature, centered modals
detail: Header titles are enlarged and capitalized (Choose a Level, Choose a Set, Practice Errors).
Level picker features an illuminated focal badge on the active level, removes redundant header level label, and places speech coverage inline after target-language example words.
Retired 'Set 1, 2, ...' in favor of card ranges (e.g. 1–25) across selectors, buttons, loading screens, and completion modals.
Refactored setup tooltip modals to be concise, scannable, and cleanly centered across both mobile and desktop viewports.

entries.summary: Inflected Portuguese rows drop dictionary notes and inflect every meaning: está 'he/she is', not 'he/she is; forms the progressive aspect'
detail: Notes beside the meanings are left off inflected rows: 'forms the progressive aspect', 'formula used in greetings', 'especially…', 'usually', 'such as…'. vai: 'he/she is doing; formula used in greetings' → 'he/she is doing'.

Meanings written without 'to' now inflect too: busca 'he/she fetches, pick up' → 'he/she fetches, picks up'; tira 'takes, take out, take away' → 'takes, takes out, takes away'; cola 'sticks or attach' → 'sticks or attaches'.
Alternatives after 'to be' stay as they are ('he/she is absent, not present'); an object alternate stays ('starts an engine, vehicle').
Measured on live v23: 232 Portuguese rows changed, no Spanish row changed, none lost its English.

entries.summary: Early level estimates suggest a particular study set
detail: Suggest a level and set within Levels 1–10, using the same 25-position set boundaries as the study picker; from Level 11 suggest whole levels.
Keep earlier and later options separate when they land in different sets of the same level, and select the chosen set after its controls finish loading.
Sample more finely near the start of the frequency range while keeping the adaptive check at up to 30 questions and preserving saved Speech-rank placement.
